title: Add Warranty IVR option and expand Sales queue
story: Marta, the support manager, wants a new IVR choice on Customer Service – Voice. Callers who choose "Warranty" should go to a new voice queue called Warranty. That queue must have 4 people to start.
Sam, the sales manager, says Sales is short staffed. He asks that the Sales queue has at least 5 members so they can handle more calls.
